<tspan x="600.0" dy="0">B: batch; theta:[B,2,3]; grid:[B,H,W,2] in normalized(x,y) coordinates</tspan>
<tspan x="600.0" dy="16.52">Solid side route: original image values; dashed side route: shape x.size()</tspan>
<tspan x="600.0" dy="16.52">Library boundaries: affine_grid and grid_sample; omitted API arguments remain omitted</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="600.0" y="762" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="600.0" dy="0">Reviewed static source + selected profile. Repeated groups are templates; shapes are not runtime observations.</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="600.0" y="792" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="600.0" dy="0">E### = source span; dashed = side / shape dependencies; fork/join roles are typed in IR; no implicit sum.</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="600.0" y="817" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="600.0" dy="0">Repeated colors encode operation roles. Shared weights and independent instances are recorded in semantic_ir.json.</tspan>
</text>
